$$

$$

$$

$$

---

---

$$

$$

---

$$
\text{Cost individually} = 40 \text{ bananas} \times 0.80 \text{ dollars per banana} = 32.00 \text{ dollars}
$$

---

### Step 3: Find the cost if she bought the bananas in bunches

$$
\text{Cost in bunches} = 10 \text{ bunches} \times 3.00 \text{ dollars per bunch} = 30.00 \text{ dollars}
$$

---

### Step 4: Find the amount saved

$$
\text{Amount saved} = \text{Cost individually} - \text{Cost in bunches} = 32.00 - 30.00 = 2.00 \text{ dollars}
$$

---

### Final Answer:

The final answer is 2.
